statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness and presyncope
The patient experiences significant dizziness and giddiness
Initial non-invasive testing has not fully characterized the patient's condition
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitor) was ordered
The service is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events during symptomatic periods
The service is ordered to evaluate for a cardiac etiology of the syncope and dizziness
Diagnosis code R55 applies to this patient
Diagnosis code R42 applies to this patient
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
The service is not separately payable under current policy guidelines
